events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller has opened the vent.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is pretending to be hospital worker Ben the janitor and is coming to the rescue.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay, acting as Ben the janitor, should be ready and should give Ross Geller Phoebe Buffay's foot on the count of three.
Susan Bunch says Phoebe Buffay is looking and asks what Phoebe Buffay sees.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay sees what appears to be a dark vent and then confirms that the vent is in fact a dark vent.
Phoebe Buffay says Susan Bunch should wait.
Ross Geller says the vent is open.
Janitor says Ross Geller and Phoebe Buffay should wait.
Janitor says Ross Geller and Phoebe Buffay have forgotten their legs.
